content: ईशान {%a.%} [ईश् ताच्छील्ये चानश्] .²1 Owning, possessing, master or lord. .²2 Reigning, ruling. .²3 Wealthy, rich. .{@-नः@} .²1 A ruler, master, lord; ईशानो भूतभव्यस्य <ls>Kaṭh. 4. 12</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva; ईशानसंदर्शनलालसानाम् <ls>Ku. 7. 56</ls>; <ls>K. 10</ls>. .²3 The Ārdrā Nakṣtra. .²4 One of the Rudras. .²5 The number ‘eleven’. .²6 The sun as a form of Śiva. पर्जन्यो यमो मृत्युरीशानः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 4. 11</ls>. .²7 A Sādhya. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .{@-नी@} <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .{@-नी, -नः@} The silk-cotton tree (शाल्मली; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>सांवरी</ns>). .{@-नम्@} Light, splendour.
